_comment: Shared case file of the heredoc-program twins (#748, #777): scripts/hooks/destructive-gate.py _heredoc_runs_body and scripts/hooks/lib/heredoc-program.mjs heredocRunsBody. cmd carries X where the payload goes; expect has one bool per record of find_all/findAll (heredocs AND here-strings, sorted by start: does the shell RUN that body?); bash_runs is what bash itself did with X=echo PWNED_MARK(_777) when the row was built. bash_note (#777) explains a row where bash_runs and expect differ on purpose: an oracle artefact of the payload framing, an accepted over-block, or a KNOWN GAP; the consistency check skips such rows, the expect check does not. Checked by scripts/__tests__/heredoc-program.test.py and src/__tests__/heredoc-program-parity.test.ts.
